info.title: Menu Sort Aroma
info.author: Yirr777
info.description: Alphabetically sort your Wii U Menu icon
info.details:
Unofficial Aroma port of Menu Sort (originally by Yardape8000 and doino-gretchenliev), rebuilt on wut + libmocha instead of the legacy Homebrew Launcher stack.

Alphabetically sorts the icons on your Wii U Menu, per user account, including inside folders and homebrew icons injected by the Homebrew On Wii U Menu plugin. Folders, system icons (Disc, Settings, etc.), the Homebrew Launcher, and any title you list in dontmove.txt / dontmove_homebrew.txt stay in place.

Controls: B standard sort, A sort ignoring a leading "The", X/Y bad-naming-mode variants, + backup current order, - restore backup, L count items only.

Always back up (+) before your first sort. An automatic backup is also taken before every real sort. Supports up to 810 titles for compatibility with the 300-title-limit bypass.

changelog:
v1.3.0-aroma3
- Raised the max sortable items from 300 to 810, for compatibility with the 300-title-limit bypass (thanks @sync-on-luma, PR #1).
- Moved the large working arrays off the thread stack into static storage so the higher limit can't overflow the stack. No behavior change.
